# InstallSmart.AI NFC Tap Cards

> Matt black NFC tap cards for UK businesses and creators, coded to open a Google Business Profile review page, an Instagram profile or a TikTok profile with one tap. £25 per card plus £3.95 Royal Mail Tracked 48. UK delivery only.

## Key facts
- Price: £25 per card, coded and tested. Postage £3.95 per order by Royal Mail Tracked 48. No monthly fees.
- Destinations: Google Business Profile (reviews), Instagram or TikTok. One destination per card.
- Compatibility: iPhone XS and later, and almost every Android phone with NFC. No app needed.
- Design: sent blank in matt black so the customer can add their own logo sticker.
- Delivery: UK addresses only. Up to 10 cards per order.
- Terms: all sales are final. No refunds or cancellations once the order is processed and the card is coded. Faulty cards are replaced free within 30 days.
